# AGENTS.md

Guidance for coding agents working in this repository. `<svc>` is a Go service built on
[gost](https://github.com/bldsoft/gost); read
[gost/docs/agent-guide.md](https://github.com/bldsoft/gost/blob/main/docs/agent-guide.md) before
changing wiring, configuration or storage code.

## Layout and layer rules

```
cmd/<svc>/main.go        entry point: ReadConfig → InitLogger → NewServer(...).Start()
pkg/config               Config struct (gost sub-configs + own fields), SetDefaults, Validate, config.md golden test
pkg/entity               domain types; imports gost base types only
pkg/repository           storage adapters; never imports service
pkg/service              business logic; interface.go declares the repositories it consumes
pkg/controller           interface.go declares the services controllers consume; rest/ holds handlers
pkg/microservice         composition root: wiring, migrations, routes, async runners
```

- Dependency direction is `controller → service → repository → entity`. The consumer declares
  the interface; `pkg/microservice` asserts conformance with `var _ I = (*T)(nil)`.
- `New(cfg)` must not touch the network; connections happen in `Initialize()`.
- Everything long-lived is a `server.AsyncRunner` returned from `GetAsyncRunners()`.

## Commands

```bash
make build / make run          # bin/<svc>; run exports dev defaults (see Makefile)
make test                      # unit + route tests, no database
make test-integration          # needs a MongoDB replica set; skips locally when unreachable, fails in CI
make lint                      # golangci-lint; must be clean before every push, no //nolint
make generate                  # mockery mocks, enumer enums; commit the output
make config-md                 # regenerate config.md after changing config tags
```

Local MongoDB:
`docker run -d --name mongo -e GLIBC_TUNABLES=glibc.pthread.rseq=1 -p 27017:27017 mongo:8 --replSet rs0 --bind_ip_all` then
`docker exec mongo mongosh --quiet --eval 'rs.initiate({_id:"rs0",members:[{_id:0,host:"127.0.0.1:27017"}]})'`.

## Configuration contract

Environment variables only, through gost `config.ReadConfig`. Adding a setting means: a field
with `mapstructure` and `description` tags, a default in `SetDefaults` (none for secrets, which
are `config.HiddenString`), a rule in `Validate` that names the variable, wiring in
`pkg/microservice`, and `make config-md`. Never call nested `SetDefaults`/`Validate`.

## Testing rules

- `testify/require`, table-driven, `-race`.
- Mocks are generated by mockery into `mocks/`; do not edit them.
- Never call `server.Start()` in tests; build a `chi.NewRouter()` and call `BuildRoutes`.
- Integration tests use `//go:build integration_test`.

## Lint and style

Source of truth: `.golangci.yml` (identical to gost's). After any code generation or edits:

1. Do not modify files marked `DO NOT EDIT` / `Code generated` (`**/mocks/`, enumer output).
2. Bring code in line with the style enforced by `make lint`.
3. Run `make lint` and fix the findings. Do not silence linters with `//nolint` unless asked.

A comment is allowed only for a contract or invariant that cannot be expressed in code and whose
violation has a concrete failure mode.
